implementation: CN4010 and CN6010 Series Common Crypto Library
description: The CN4010 and CN6010 Series Common Crypto Library Module provides FIPS 140-2 approved cryptographic algorithms for the CN4010 and CN6010 Series Encryptors. Based upon OpenSSL the Library provides an Application Programming Interface (API) to support security relevant services.
vendor: Senetas Corporation Ltd. and SafeNet Inc.
